visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene starts in a brightly lit bathroom. A woman with short brown hair, wearing a white lacy slip dress, is seen sitting on a toilet with a distressed facial expression. She looks around frantically, discovering there is no toilet paper. (2) A second character, visually identical but wearing a red and white school-style uniform with red suspenders, appears at the bathroom door. She holds up two small, colorful square tissue packs—one blue, one red—smiling broadly at the camera. (3) The woman in the white dress is shown in a montage sequence, imagining the consequences of picking each color based on an urban legend. Visual overlays show her head appearing on a toilet bowl (red) and then her skin turning a vibrant blue (blue). (4) The character in the red uniform then presents a large, clear plastic-wrapped multi-pack of tissue paper featuring cartoon bear characters. The woman in white accepts it and is seen happily using a tissue in a dining room setting. (5) The woman is then seen in an indoor living area, wearing a grey sports bra and leggings, sitting on a yoga mat. She looks sweaty and again searches for tissue. (6) The red-uniformed character reappears, teasingly holding a single tissue. The scene cuts to a detailed product close-up where a hand touches the 3-layer tissue paper, demonstrating its softness. (7) Finally, both versions of the woman appear together in a living room, holding the product and celebrating as sparkles appear on screen.
